[South-eastern Baltic] LITHUANIAN NAV WARN 045/26
SOUTH-EASTERN BALTIC. LITHUANIAN COAST.
MILITARY EXERCISES 020600–051200 UTC JUN
IN AREA EYD-18, CENTERED IN 55-29.6N 020-51.0E.
AREA TEMPORARILY DANGEROUS TO SHIPPING.
WIDE BERTH REQUESTED.
CANCEL 051300 UTC JUN 26.
